primary_sources_checked.source: Kotłowski & Grünwald 2011, Maximum Likelihood vs. Sequential Normalized Maximum Likelihood in On-line Density Estimation
primary_sources_checked.result: Primary Gaussian unknown-mean/unknown-variance SNML source confirms the Student-t predictive form and exact per-round regret increment used by r68/r72; the increment is asymptotically 1/n+O(n^-2).

primary_sources_checked.source: Clopper & Pearson 1934, The Use of Confidence or Fiducial Limits Illustrated in the Case of the Binomial
primary_sources_checked.result: Primary exact-binomial confidence-limit source for the one-sided Monte Carlo failure-probability envelopes.

deterministic_checks.pair_failure_logic: For a fixed (Q,x), pair failure is F_early intersect F_late, hence its probability is at most min(P(F_early),P(F_late)). This requires no early/late independence. Simultaneous one-sided marginal upper limits plus a union bound therefore justify taking min(U_early,U_late) pointwise.

independent_reimplementation.implementation_basis: Independent implementation from the role-local published formulas only: Gaussian block maximized log likelihood from aggregate mean/SSE; exact Kotlowski-Grunwald regret sum; subgroup mean M_h=mu_h+sigma_h Z/sqrt(n_h), within-SSE W_h=sigma_h^2 ChiSq(n_h-1), and exact between-group SSE aggregation; early/late subgroup compositions exactly as r72.
independent_reimplementation.variance_grid: 15 log-spaced variance ratios over each complete normalized Gaussian KL=I level
independent_reimplementation.replication_result: All three independently reconstructed finite-grid worst upper bounds remain below beta=0.10 and are close to the worker's reported values. This supports the finite-grid operating claim under a fresh Monte Carlo realization.

assessment.scope: The Clopper-Pearson/union-bound statement certifies Monte Carlo uncertainty only at the 765 scanned parameter points. It does not control unsampled variance-ratio/offset points and must not be promoted to a continuum theorem.

integration_guidance: Keep r72 as strong finite-grid randomized evidence for the 10-state design, but preserve the distinction between fresh independent replication and exact historical replay. Any downstream claim should retain the finite-grid scope and provenance gap until an immutable code/seed/result bundle or a deterministic continuum proof exists.
